scientific_integrity: Analytical proof of conditional first and second moments; direct symbolic integrations and reproducible geometric simulations support but do not replace it. Marginal crossing-count moments are credited as prior.
scientific_limitations: Independent uniformly sampled circle endpoints only; no extension to other chord models or full conditional law. Conditional pairwise independence is not mutual independence. Historical originality risk of implicit derivation; independent scientific audit not performed.
title: Exact second-order prediction of random chord crossings from chord lengths
